style: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a simple professional dimensional textbook diagram for a high-school physics multiple-choice question. White background, polished realistic 3D objects with subtle shading, crisp legible black labels, generous whitespace, landscape composition. Only the specified relevant diagram and values, no question sentences, no answer, no title or watermark.

prompts.prompt: Two identical neutral objects on insulating stands labelled A and B, a curved arrow A to B carrying small blue electron symbols; text only 'A','B','5.0 × 10¹² electrons','e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C','Initially neutral'. Do not show final charges.
Two equal-sized polished spheres side by side isolated white background, left red sphere labelled '+2 μC', right red sphere labelled '+5 μC'. No arrows, no force results, no other text.

Two vertically stacked charge setups. Upper pair metallic spheres labelled 'q₁' and 'q₂' with horizontal distance bracket 'r'. Lower pair labelled '3q₁' and 'q₂' distance bracket '2r', visually twice the separation. Labels 'Initial' and 'Changed'. No force arrows, no formulas or result.

Two metallic charged spheres on insulating stands, left red labelled '+4.0 μC', right blue labelled '−1.0 μC', center-to-center dimension line '0.20 m'. Small given constant label 'k = 8.99 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²'. No force arrows or result.

A red sphere with plus sign at left labelled 'Source'. At right a small blue negative particle at point 'P'. One straight upward arrow from P labelled 'v'. No electric field or force arrows, no other text.

A positive red source sphere at left labelled '+2.0 μC' and small blue probe at right labelled 'P' and '−3.0 nC'. Horizontal center spacing dimension '0.20 m'. Given constant 'k = 8.99 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²'. No force or field arrows or result.

Point P marked by small blue negative sphere. Two perpendicular field vector arrows from P: long arrow right labelled '12 N/C east' and shorter arrow up labelled '5 N/C north', lengths ratio12:5. Text 'P' and minus sign. Do not show resultant vector or force.

Two vertical parallel metallic plates in slight perspective. Left labelled '90 V', right labelled '0 V'. Horizontal spacing dimension '0.030 m'. Small red bead between labelled '+4.0 μC', leftward motion arrow labelled 'v = constant'. No field arrows, energy or work results.

Two locations indicated by thin vertical dashed planes labelled '20 V' on left and '80 V' on right. A small blue sphere labelled '−3.0 μC' moves left to right, arrow labelled 'v = constant'. Minimal dimensional physics diagram no energy results, no field arrows.

Two side-by-side setups labelled 'A' and 'B', each two parallel metallic plates. A disconnected capacitor with free unconnected leads, label 'Q fixed'. B capacitor connected by two separate wires to opposite terminals of small battery labelled '60 V'. Under each, label 'Initial: 60 V' and a simple gap-change dimension '2 cm → 4 cm'. No final voltage/field values, no charge markings. Ensure physically coherent circuit wires.

One smooth silver metallic sphere on narrow clear insulating stand centered in generous white space. Label 'Metal sphere' and small annotation 'Excess charge'. Opaque solid sphere, no cutaway, no surface charge symbols, no internal field or answer, no other objects.

Blue insulating rod at left with three minus signs, held close without touching a silver metal sphere on clear insulating stand. Wire from sphere right side goes to standard ground symbol. Labels 'Negative rod', 'Metal sphere', 'Ground'. No charge distribution on sphere, no electron flow arrows, no sequence or answer.

Small realistic textbook cutaway house roof with pointed metal lightning air terminal connected to copper down-conductor. Clearly visible small break in conductor on house side, two wire ends separated; ground rod continues below soil. Labels 'Air terminal', 'Broken connection', 'Ground rod' with fine leader lines. No lightning bolt or current arrows, no explanation.

Simple closed single-loop circuit with dimensional battery labelled 'V', resistor component labelled 'R', connecting wires and one small conventional current direction arrow labelled 'I'. White background textbook perspective, battery plus and minus visible, arrow externally from positive through resistor to negative. No formula.

Dimensional illustration of a real battery, + and − terminals both connected directly by a single loop of metal wire with no load. Label 'Battery' and 'Low-resistance wire'. No fire, no current magnitude or answer, simple textbook diagram.

A single realistic axial resistor connected to wire leads left and right, label '5 Ω' above resistor, rightward arrow on wire 'I = 2 A'. Two fine terminal markers show measurement across resistor labelled 'V'. No calculated voltage or formula.

Accurate simple V-versus-I graph. Vertical axis label 'V (V)', horizontal 'I (A)'. Both start zero. Straight blue line through origin and two marked points exactly (0.20 A,3.0 V) and (0.60 A,9.0 V). Points labeled '(0.20 A, 3.0 V)' and '(0.60 A, 9.0 V)'. Axis ticks at 0,0.20,0.40,0.60 and0,3.0,6.0,9.0. Clean textbook graph, no slope result or resistance.

Two diagrams side-by-side labels 'Series' and 'Parallel'. Series has one battery labelled 'V' in single closed loop with exactly three identical bulbs sequentially. Parallel has one battery labelled 'V' connected to two rails with exactly three separate branches, each one identical bulb. Draw all bulbs unlit neutral glass, not brightness comparison. Use clear dimensional miniature components and perfectly coherent wires. No formula or outcome.

Single battery labelled 'V' connected to two rails, three parallel branches each with one identical glass bulb. Top bulb filament clearly broken, label 'Open filament'. All bulbs neutral unlit illustration without brightness indication. Correct circuit topology no accidental short, labels only 'V' and 'Open filament'.

Dimensional textbook illustration of a battery and switch connected into a circuit, straight elevated wire section passing just above a round compass. Compass needle has no motion arrows or before-after. Labels 'Battery', 'Wire', 'Compass'. No field lines or answer.

Two otherwise identical electromagnet setups side by side, each same battery connected to insulated copper coil on iron nail. Left coil fewer turns, right more turns. Label left 'Fewer turns', right 'More turns', both batteries 'Same battery'. Small loose paper clips lying separately nearby, none lifted. No results or field arrows.

Three identical-looking iron nail electromagnets with neutral copper coils side by side labelled 'A','B','C'. Under A exactly '24 clips' and 'Cost: 8.00'. Under B '36 clips' and 'Cost: 12.00'. Under C '35 clips' and 'Cost: 10.00'. No actual clip piles, only one tiny decorative paperclip beside label if needed. No ratios, percentage or answer, all three same visual emphasis.

Two identical nail electromagnet illustrations side by side with neutral coils, labelled '0.50 A' and '1.00 A'. Under first concise given-data row 'Trials: 9, 10, 11 clips'; under second 'Trials: 18, 20, 19 clips'. No actual paperclip counts drawn, no averages or conclusions.

Three identical-looking nail electromagnets side by side labelled 'A','B','C'. Given data under A '30 clips', 'Cost: 10.00', 'Wire: 180 cm'; under B '42 clips','Cost: 12.00','Wire: 220 cm'; under C '54 clips','Cost: 12.00','Wire: 270 cm'. Small neutral header 'Limits: 250 cm wire; cost 50.00'. No outcomes, no highlighting eligibility, no ratios. Align data clearly.

Two separate closed copper wire coils side by side labelled 'A' and 'B'. A labels 'ε = 2.0 V' and 'R = 5.0 Ω'; B labels 'ε = 2.0 V' and 'R = 10 Ω'. Each coil is a closed electrical loop with resistor joining coil ends. No current value or direction.

Bar magnet horizontally at left, south blue at left end labelled 'S', north red right end labelled 'N'. Magnet approaches copper closed circular coil at right coaxially, rightward straight arrow above magnet labelled 'v'. Near face of coil visible in slight perspective from magnet side, small eye-view arrow labelled 'View from magnet'. No current arrow, no coil pole label, no force arrows.

Simple dimensional copper multi-turn coil in white space, a few blue parallel magnetic field arrows threading through its opening along axis. Labels only 'N = 80', 'ΔΦ = +0.0030 Wb per turn', 'Δt = 0.20 s'. No induced emf result, no equations, no exact depiction of80 turns needed schematic.

Simple textbook motor coil between red magnetic pole N at left and blue S at right. Small shaft through coil, clean metallic supports. Labels only 'I: 2.0 A → 4.0 A' and 'B, A, N, θ fixed'. Do not draw torque magnitude, no result, no spinning motion claim.

Dimensional AC generator model, copper rectangular rotating coil between magnet poles N and S, shaft and slip rings. Curved rotation arrow labelled 'ω → 2ω'. Small labels 'Initial peak: 6.0 V' and 'Initial frequency: 10 Hz'. No final voltage or frequency, no result.

Small realistic electric motor in middle, arrow enters from left label 'Electrical energy: 500 J', arrow leaves shaft to right label 'Useful shaft work: 350 J'. Small neutral label 'ΔEstored = 0'. No other arrows or energy labels, no calculated remainder or heat/sound answer.

Two textbook cutaway device illustrations side by side, moving-coil dynamic microphone at left and moving-coil loudspeaker at right. Show diaphragm/cone, copper moving coil, permanent magnet with simple object labels 'Microphone', 'Speaker', 'Coil', 'Magnet'. No directional energy flow arrows or operating explanations. White background restrained detail.

Dimensional generator at left connected by two insulated wires to motor at right. Left input shaft arrow labelled '300 J mechanical'. Generator label 'Generator: 80%'; motor label 'Motor: 75%'. Motor output shaft visible with neutral unlabeled arrow. No intermediate energy numbers, no final output or combined efficiency.

Two side-by-side copper coils connected to matching regulated supplies. Left coil label '3.0 Ω', right coil '2.0 Ω'. Each supply clearly 'I = 2.0 A'. Small labels 'Before' and 'After'. No heat glow, no power values, no result.

Three identical small dimensional generator models in equally emphasized columns D,E,F. Under D '8.2 V peak', 'Cost: 68'; E '7.8 V peak','Cost: 55'; F '9.4 V peak','Cost: 82'. Neutral compact header 'Vpeak ≥ 8.0 V; cost ≤ 70'. No eligibility markings or answer.
